Zemlja nije (samo) prostor, nisu samo planine, rijeke, doline, zemlja su, prije svega, ljudi. Zemlju ne čine zastave, politički pamfleti, zemlju čine obični ljudi sa svakodnevnim životima, radostima i tugama... O toj i takvoj zemlji govori novi serijal Informativnog programa BHT1, "Moja zemlja", koji uređuje i, vozeći svoj oldtimer obilazi s kraja na kraj čudesne Bosne i Hercegovine, vodi Elvir Bucalo.

programme.title: We have a pope / Habemus Papam
programme.desc: The new season of the BHT1 religious program will be opened by the reportage "Habemus Papam", which brings a review of the conclave and dial of the new chief of the Catholic Church of Pope Lava XIV. Reporting record "Habemus Papam" brings the memory of the three previous hikes of the Pope to Bosnia and Herzegovina, Pope John Paul II. and Pope Francis as a bearer of peace message. The conclave, which began after the death of Pope Francis and was selected by the new head of the Catholic Church. Among the Cardinals of the menus the oldest with the right of voice was Vinko Cardinal Puljić. In the report, the Cardinal brings his view of the importance of a conclave that takes place in secret, but also the importance of moments that discussed the state of the Church and what is expected from the new Pope Lava XIV. / Novu sezonu emisija religijskog programa BHT1 otvoriti će reportaža "Habemus Papam" koja donosi osvrt na konklavu i biranje novoga poglavara Katoličke crkve pape Lava XIV. Reportažni zapis "Habemus Papam" donosi sjećanje na tri prethodna pohoda papa Bosni i Hercegovini, pape Ivana Pavla II. i pape Franje kao nositelja poruke mira. Konklavi, koja je počela nakon smrti pape Franje i kojom se birao novi poglavar Katoličke Crkve. Među kardinalima izbornicima najstariji s pravom glasa bio je Vinko kardinal Puljić. U reportaži kardinal donosi svoj pogled na važnosti konklave koja se odvija u tajnosti, ali i na važnost momenata u kojima se raspravljalo o stanju Crkve i što se očekuje od novoga pape Lava XIV.

programme.desc: Emission of nature, environment and sustainable development in BiH. He brings stories from the field, talks with experts and presentation of environmental and agricultural projects that change local communities. / Emisija o prirodi, okolišu i održivom razvoju u BiH. Donosi priče s terena, razgovore sa stručnjacima i prikaz ekoloških i poljoprivrednih projekata koji mijenjaju lokalne zajednice.

programme.title: Nova Avantura / Nova avantura
programme.desc: In the show on the history, tradition and customs of the population in the Valley of the White River, at the foot of the Massives of Prenja and Borašnica. This valley has been inhabited since ancient times. There were remains of prehistoric ceramics, Illyrian buildings as well as traces of Roman road. Here today there are several villages and hamlets called by people in one name white. / U emisiji o historiji, tradiciji i običajima stanovništva u dolini rijeke Bijele, u podnožju masiva Prenja i Borašnice. Ova dolina je bila naseljena još od davnih vremena. Tu su pronađeni ostaci prahistorijske keramike, ilirskih gradina kao i tragovi rimske ceste. Ovdje se danas nalazi nekoliko sela i zaseoka koje ljudi jednim imenom nazivaju Bijela.

programme.title: Fundus / Fundus
programme.desc: "Fundus" is a TV story format whose themes are BH. Cultural and historical heritage, unknown stories and details from our heritage, but also a reminder of valuable cultural treasure that preserve museums across the country. The best promotion of the state is through its rich and varied culture. Museum depots keep thousands of valuable cases and exhibits, including numerous world rarities. Collections and collections do not even lag behind the settings in reputable European and world museums. This form of BHRT wants to present them to the general public and remind them of their value. The stories are processed only by basic and most interesting details, with the aim of encouraging viewers to visit museums and institutions in which exhibits are found. In the fundus you will see the interesting facts you haven't known so far, the items you haven't seen before, and it will also present part of the tradition on which there is no information recorded. / "Fundus" je format TV priča čije su teme bh. kulturno-historijsko naslijeđe, nepoznate priče i detalji iz naše baštine, ali i podsjećanje na vrijedno kulturno blago koje čuvaju muzeji širom zemlje. Najbolja promocija države je preko njene bogate i raznovrsne kulture. Muzejski depoi čuvaju hiljade vrijednih predmeta i eksponata, među kojima su brojni svjetski rariteti. Kolekcije i zbirke ni po čemu ne zaostaju za postavkama u uglednim evropskim i svjetskim muzejima. Ovom formom BHRT želi da ih predstavi široj javnosti i podsjeti na njihovu vrijednost. Priče obrađuju samo osnovne i najzanimljivije detalje, s ciljem da potaknu gledatelje da za više informacija posjete muzeje i ustanove u kojima se nalaze eksponati. U Fundusu ćete vidjeti zanimljivosti koje do sada niste znali, predmete koje niste prije vidjeli, a predstaviće i dio tradicije o kojoj nema zabilježenih informacija.

programme.title: It was once ... / Bilo jednom...
programme.desc: We bring a documentary "Once ..." that talks about the war years in Bosnia and Herzegovina. / Donosimo dokumentarni film "Bilo jednom..." koji govori o ratnim godinama u Bosni i Hercegovini.

programme.title: Waking dreams / Budni snovi
programme.desc: Jenita Zirdum takes us on a journey through the best guarded treasure of South America. Touching untouchable and discover the mysticism of Inca in ancient Peru is a motive of travelogue that reveals in a special way culture, habits and customs from the heights of the Andes to the rainforest of Amazonia. The expedition starts from the sea level to 5000 meters where we convey the wisdom of ancestors and learning from local communities. / Dženita Zirdum vodi nas na putovanje kroz najbolje čuvana blaga Južne Amerike. Dodirnuti nedodirljivo i otkrivati mistiku Inka u drevnom Peruu motiv je putopisa koji na poseban način otkriva kulturu, navike i običaje od visina Anda do prašume Amazonije. Ekspedicija počinje od nivoa mora do 5000 metara gdje prenosimo mudrosti predaka i učenja od lokalnih zajednica.

programme.title: Slightly inheritance / Blago naslijeđa
programme.desc: TV series on cultural and historical treasure, as well as the traditional values ​​of the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina. The story of life in this region ... creation, beauty, history, culture, and construction. What does a slight heritage really mean, how much attention do we pay to him, how much do we know about him? / TV serijal o kulturnom i historijskom blagu, kao i o tradicionalnim vrijednostima područja Bosne i Hercegovine. Priča o životu na ovim prostorima... stvaranju, ljepoti, historiji, kulturi, i graditeljstvu. Što blago naslijeđa zapravo znači, koliko mu pažnje posvećujemo, koliko znamo o njemu?

programme.title: Draft / Propuh
programme.desc: The emission on an alternative music scene in BiH and the region, in which we present part of what is currently most interesting in punk, metal, hardcore and noise scene, as well as in the field of all other music genres and subgregants, under the common name alternative. The show, above all, is inspired by the expansion of alternative music in BiH in recent years, as well as new spaces, real and virtual, in which alternative culture is happening. / Emisija o alternativnoj muzičkoj sceni u BiH i regionu, u kojoj predstavljamo dio onoga što je trenutno najzanimljivije na punk, metal, hardcore i noise sceni, kao i u oblasti svih drugih muzičkih žanrova i podžanrova, pod zajedničkim nazivom alternativna. Emisija je, prije svega, inspirisana ekspanzijom alternativne muzike u BiH posljednjih godina, kao i novim prostorima, stvarnim i virtualnim, u kojima se alternativna kultura dešava.

programme.title: Dimension more special / Dimenzija više specijal
programme.desc: The festival art after the summer, and the spring cans are the most striking forerunner of the festival reality during the summer months, which is mostly recognized through film festivals, but the theater is not lagging behind. The ambient art meeting with consumers has become very important, and a very favorite in the audience. That is why this is a small journey through a few festival, from Kana to Balkan, as a reminder of the magic of the Croaazeta Film Coast, through the Balkan Film Festival in Belgrade, the Pula Film Festival as the oldest national film festival in Europe, the Ulyses Theater Festival on Brijuni, which marked the 25th anniversary of the Sarajevo Film Festival. The decade of his ascent on the Festival Challenge ladder during the summer ... In the dimension more special about another regional film festival, the Montenegro Film Festival in Herceg Novi, then 82. Festival in Venice, where he won Jim Jarmusch with the movie "Mother Sister Brother" in which Cate Blanchett, Adam Driver, and Tom Waits complex relationships between adult children and their remote parents. His brilliant directorial career has been certified in Cana for years and confirmed by the Golden Lion in Venice. / O festivalskoj umjetnosti nakon ljeta, a proljetni Kan najupečatljivija je preteča festivalske zbilje tokom ljetnih mjeseci, koja se mahom prepoznaje kroz filmske festivale, ali ni teatar ne zaostaje. Ambijentalni susret umjetnosti s konzumentima postao je veoma važan, a kod publike veoma omiljen. Zato je ovo jedno malo putovanje kroz nekolicinu festivala, od Kana do Balkana, kao podsjetnik na čari filmske Kroazete na Azurnoj obali, preko Balkanskog festivala filmske režije u Beogradu, Pula Film Festivala kao najstarijeg nacionalnog filmskog festivala u Evropi, Ulyses teatarskog festivala na Brijunima koji je obilježio 25 godina trajanja, preko Sarajevo Film Festivala koji je zakoračio u četvrtu deceniju svoga uspona na ljestvici festivalskih izazova tokom ljeta... U Dimenziji više specijal o još jednom regionalnom filmskom festivalu, Montenegro film festival u Herceg Novom, potom 82. festivalu u Veneciji gdje je pobijedio Jim Jarmusch sa filmom "Otac Majka Sestra Brat" u kome glume Cate Blanchett, Adam Driver i Tom Waits, komedija-drama koja istražuje složene odnose između odrasle djece i njihovih udaljenih roditelja. Njegova sjajna rediteljska karijera godinama je ovjeravana baš u Kanu, a potvrđena i Zlatnim lavom u Veneciji.

programme.title: Football: League 1 of France: 4 round: Lyon - Anger / Футбол: Лига 1 на Франция: 4 кръг: Лион - Анже
programme.desc: League 1 consists of 20 teams that compete against each other in 38 rounds, changed. The French Championship dates from 1892, the so -called Amateur League until 1929. In 1932, the foundations of professionally organized football in France were laid. The French Division 1 includes in its first season 1932-33 the following teams, divided into two groups: Club France, Excelsior, Ier, Lille, Marseille, Muluz, Nice, Nim, Racing Paris, Ale, Antib, Khan, are Paris, Fiv, Montz, Red Star, Ren and Sosho. In recent years, much later the formed club Paris Saint-Germain has been an absolute dominant on the home stage, but before that, Lyon, Marseille, Bordeaux, Monaco, Nan, Saint Etienne, Reim, Nice, Lance and more have also had many successes. / Лига 1 се състои от 20 отбора, които се състезават един срещу друг в 38 кръга, на разменено гостуване. Френският шампионат датира от 1892, така нареченета Аматьорска лига до 1929. През 1932 се полагат основите на професионално организраният футбол във Франция. Френската Дивизия 1 включва в своя първи сезон 1932-33 следните отбори, разделени в две групи: Клуб Франсе, Екселсиор, Иер, Лил, Марсилия, Мюлуз, Ница, Ним, Расинг Париж, Сет, Але, Антиб, Кан, СА Париж, Фив, Метц, Монпелие, Ред Стар, Рен и Сошо. През последните години доста по-късно сформирания клуб Пари Сен Жермен е абсолютен доминатор на домашната сцена, но преди това много успехи са имали също Лион, Марсилия, Бордо, Монако, Нан, Сен Етиен, Рейм, Ница, Ланс и др.

programme.title: Football: Premier League: 5 round: Bournemouth - Newcastle United / Футбол: Висша лига: 5 кръг: Борнемут - Нюкасъл Юнайтед
programme.desc: The English Premier League, also known as the Premier League or Premiership, is the highest level division in English football. The Premier League is the most watched Sports League and the richest championship in the world. The race was founded in 1888 as the First Division and transformed in 1992 as the Premier League. The most successful teams are: Manchester Yu, Liverpool, Arsenal, Everton, Manchester with, Aston Villa, Sunderland and Chelsea. / Английската Висша лига, известна още като Премиър лига или Премиършип (Premier League или Premiership), е дивизията от най-високо ниво в английския футбол. Висшата лига е най-гледаната спортна лига и най-богатото първенство в света. Надпреварата е основана през 1888 като Първа дивизия и трансформирана през 1992 като Висша лига. Основатели на Първа дивизия през 1888 са Акрингтън, Астън Вила, Блекбърн, Болтън, Бърнли, Дарби К, Евертън, Уулвърхамптън, Стоук С, Уест Бромич, Нотс К и Престън. Най-успешните отбори са: Манчестър Ю, Ливърпул, Арсенал, Евертън, Манчестър С, Астън Вила, Съндърланд и Челси.

Gay Harden), an ardent believer who bothering others with his moralizing. When the fog soon covers the whole place and when it is discovered to hide the monsters that devour people, everyone realizes that they must remain hidden in the store and organize defense. But this will not be easy to do because the struggle for life will turn some people into psychotic killers, and some others into sacrificial persons and heroes ... programme.desc: One Eight Seven - (Drama, USA, 1997) in the education system that is on the edge of the collapse, one man is pushed to the edge of the downfall. Trevor Garfield (Samuel L. Jackson), a dedicated professor of natural sciences at a high school in Brooklyn, has painstakingly worked in a system where the pursuit of education has often been in the second plane in relation to a constant struggle for mere survival. He watched his school turn into a war zone, as his students divide into the camp: a few who want to learn over time have been pushed by those angry with the world that excludes them. Such students began to answer the questions with violence. While working in that siege, Trevor revealed that his commitment had crossed the boundaries of reason. When he refused to give a passing grade to one of the unpredictable and sociopathic students, that student revealed himself to him so that he stabbed him in the back and left him on the verge of death. A year later, full of real and emotional scars and shaken spirit, Trevor returns to a school in Los Angeles and found himself in the same world and violence, which he hoped to have left him behind. For his new colleagues Davea Chidlress (John Heard) and Ellen Henry (Kelly Rowan), a fresh and optimistic teacher, he is also a reluctant hero and inspiring enigma. Most of his new students are just a figure to be neglected. But Trevor's devotion is tarnished with something darker: she faces the challenge of school clerks who have no power because of the fear of a possible court dispute and is facing a group of desperate students who would rather beat themselves than study. And now no one is quite sure how far this transformed man is ready to go. R.: Kevin Reynolds Ul.: Samuel L. Trevor Garfield (Samuel L. Jackson), predani profesor prirodnih znanosti u srednjoj školi u Brooklynu, mukotrpno je radio u sustavu u kojem je težnja za obrazovanjem često bila u drugom planu u odnosu na stalnu borbu za puko preživljavanje. Gledao je kako se njegova škola pretvara u ratnu zonu, kako se njegovi učenici dijele u tabore: nekolicinu onih koji žele učiti s vremenom se su više potiskivali oni ljuti na svijet koji ih isključuje. Takvi su učenici počeli na pitanja odgovarati nasiljem. Dok je radio u tom opsadnom stanju, Trevor je otkrio da je njegova predanost prešla granice razuma. Kada je odbio dati prolaznu ocjenu jednom od nepredvidljivih i sociopatskih učenika, taj mu se učenik osvetio tako da ga je ubo nožem u leđa i ostavio ga na rubu smrti. Godinu dana poslije, pun stvarnih i emocionalnih ožiljaka te potresenog duha, Trevor se vraća predavati u školu u Los Angelesu i nađe se u istom svijetu amorala i nasilja za koji se nadao da ga je ostavio za sobom. Za svoje nove kolege Davea Chidlressa (John Heard) i Ellen Henry (Kelly Rowan), svježu i optimističnu nastavnicu, on je istovremeno i nevoljki junak i inspirativna enigma. Većini svojih novih učenika on je samo brojka koju treba zanemariti. No Trevorova predanost okaljana je nečim mračnijim: suočava se s izazovom školskih činovnika koji nemaju nikakvu moć zbog straha od mogućeg sudskog spora i suočava se sa skupinom očajnih učenika koji bi se radije tukli nego učili. I sada nitko nije sasvim siguran koliko je daleko ovaj preobraženi čovjek spreman ići. R.: Kevin Reynolds Ul.: Samuel L. Jackson (Trevor Garfield), John Heard (Dave Childress), Kelly Rowan (Ellen Henry), Clifton Collins Jr. (Cesar Sanchez), Karina Arroyave (Rita)...

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E29, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Provece owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E29, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.desc: Sue Perkins Big American Road Trip - (E02, Tourism Program, England, 2022) Sue Perkins is driving through the dramatic landscape of the Colorado state, a paradise for excursions, from desert and prairie to high mountains. While driving in his classic camper van, Sue wonders if such a lifestyle may not be too heavy and folding for her and tries to determine if it is easier to be on the move when you are with your family or in the community. He goes to the wall and meets Justin and Juby, a young couple who concluded that life on the move is not just for adults, but life with a young child is getting harder. He then goes to several parts of the rock, along the Arkansas River and meets Jamie, YouTuber, who has shown his master skills to other ambitious caravans that they can join time and tools and build a community. He finally arrives at Gutted - a unique, annual festival for the Colorado desert - a tribe meeting from all over North America. programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E29, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Provece owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E29, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: Recreation / Rekreacija
programme.desc: Recreation - (Show Magazine, Croatia, 2025) In the first episode, we go for a quick walk to Maksimir Park Forest. programme.title: Nike's big risk: Alberto Salazar / Nikeov veliki rizik: Alberto Salazar
programme.desc: Nikes Big Bet - (Doc. Film, Germany, 2021) The best athletic national team in history has fallen apart when her coach, legendary Alberto Salazar, has received a four -year prohibition of training for doping. The Salazar Stud Farm World Champion and elite national team remained in shock just when they had to go out on the track. During this time, his opponents and veterans around the world have been fierce discussions: some believed that Salazar was a monster of athletics, and others defended him as the greatest coach in history, which was convicted on the basis of very questionable evidence. The fact is that none of the athletes who trained Salazar for a decade have been positive for doping testing even though they have been carried out for thousands of them. In the end, the US Anti -Doping Agency (USADA) made a decision and did not intend it. Salazar turned out. Seven days later, Nike's Oregon project (NOP) was abolished. Two weeks after that, Mark Parker, Nike Director General, left. This movie will reveal the truth about what actually happened by presenting the views of all sides, including Nike and Salazar, as well as athletes and sports executives who believe that Salazar crossed the border. R.: Paul Kemp Ul.: Ben Andrews (Self), Chris Chavez (Self - Sports Illustrated), Malcolm Gladwell (Self - Writer and Podcaster), Ken Goe (Self - SportSwriter, The Oregonian), Kara Gouher (Self) ... / Nikes Big Bet - (dok. film, Njemačka, 2021) Najbolja atletska reprezentacija u povijesti raspala se kad je njezin trener, legendarni Alberto Salazar, dobio četverogodišnju zabranu treniranja zbog dopinga. Salazarova ergela svjetskih prvaka i elitnih reprezentativaca ostala je u šoku baš kad su morali izaći na stazu. Za to su vrijeme njegovi protivnici i branitelji diljem svijeta vodili žestoke rasprave: neki su smatrali da je Salazar pošast atletike, a drugi su ga branili kao najvećeg trenera u povijesti koji je osuđen na temelju vrlo upitnih dokaza. Činjenica je da nijedan od sportaša koje je Salazar trenirao tijekom desetljeća nije bio pozitivan na dopinškom testiranju iako ih je provedeno na tisuće. Na koncu je američka antidopinška agencija (USADA) donijela odluku i nije ju kanila promijeniti. Salazar je ispao. Sedam dana poslije ukinut je Nikeov Oregonski projekt (NOP). Dva tjedna poslije toga Mark Parker, glavni direktor Nikea, je otišao. Ovaj će film razotkriti istinu o tome što se zapravo dogodilo iznoseći stajališta svih strana, uključujući Nike i Salazara, ali i sportaša i sportskih rukovoditelja koji smatraju da je Salazar prešao granicu. programme.title: Location, location, location / Lokacija, lokacija, lokacija
programme.desc: Location, Location, Location - (S27, E06, Doc. Film, England, 2024) The most suitable customers in the United Kingdom are looking for real estate. They hope that the Leaders and real estate agents and the Kirstie Allsopp and Phil Spencer will find the perfect home in the desired location. But compromises are sometimes necessary, and customers don't always get everything they want. Find your dream home on the flu threating real estate market sometimes is not so easy. In the past few years, the real estate market has experienced flourity, but then sales suddenly slowed down due to growing interest rates and increasing the costs of life. Therefore, potential customers must be well and brought well and bring the right decision. R.: Simon Joslin ... / Location, Location, Location - (S27, E06, dok. film, Engleska, 2024) Najizbirljiviji kupci u Ujedinjenom Kraljevstvu u potrazi su za nekretninama. Nadaju se da će im voditelji i agenti za nekretnine Kirstie Allsopp i Phil Spencer pronaći savršen dom na željenoj lokaciji. No kompromisi su katkad nužni, a kupci ne dobiju uvijek sve što žele. Pronaći svoj dom iz snova na fluktuirajućem tržištu nekretnina ponekad i nije tako lako. U proteklih je nekoliko godina tržište nekretnina doživjelo procvat, no onda je prodaja naglo usporila zbog rastućih kamatnih stopa i povećanja troškova života. Stoga potencijalni kupci moraju dobro sve odvagnuti i donijeti pravu odluku. R.: Simon Joslin...

programme.title: Wonderful World of Design - United Kingdom / Čudesni svijet dizajna - Ujedinjeno Kraljevstvo
programme.desc: Grand Designs - (S22, E05, Doc. Series, England, 2024) Waterworks can be unusual and dramatic homes, but also nightmares when they need to be remodeled into a living space, due to their industrial shape, construction and height. Adam and Tassy opted for a 20 -meter concrete pole in Northamptonshire. Although he was abandoned for almost 40 years, they decided to turn it into a fun family home of rounded walls, with slides, secret rooms, fire pillars, swimming pool and garden under a clear sky. In order to fund this, they decided to sell a house in the city and raise a mortgage to gather £ 400,000, and make all the work on their own, even though they have two young children and a third on their way. R .: Marc Beers ... / Grand Designs - (S22, E05, dok. serija, Engleska, 2024) Vodotornjevi mogu biti neuobičajeni i dramatični domovi, ali i noćna mora kad ih treba preurediti u stambeni prostor, zbog njihova industrijskog oblika, konstrukcije i visine. Adam i Tassy odlučili su se za betonski stup od 20 metara u Northamptonshireu. Iako je stajao napušten gotovo 40 godina, odlučili su pretvoriti ga u zabavni obiteljski dom zaobljenih zidova, s toboganima, tajnim sobama, vatrogasnim stupom, bazenom i vrtom pod vedrim nebom. Da bi to financirali, odlučili su prodati kuću u gradu i dići hipoteku kako bi skupili 400.000 funta, a sve radove napraviti sami, iako imaju dvoje male djece i treće na putu. R.: Marc Beers...

programme.desc: Rick Steins Cornwall - (S01, E06, Educational Program, England, 2021) Rick to the interior, from the magnificent River Camel to one of the best British vineyards and reveals that the Cornwol's climate is ideal for the production of some of the country's best wines. Pokušava uloviti najbržu britansku ribu, a zatim od ulova na roštilju sprema jelo nadahnuto putovanjem u Gou. programme.title: Jamie's soul food / Jamiejeva hrana za dušu
programme.desc: Jamies Comfort Food - (E06, known. Pop. Series, England, 2014) In the sixth episode of Jamie, the favorite British dish from the pub, ham with eggs and fries will enrich the spicy Jamaicic marinade. It will also prepare a simple but elegant pasta dish with fine crustaceans, thinly sliced ​​fennel and a little hot pepper. Jamie's third recipe will be a gorgeous chocolate cake - a three -story masterpiece filled with chocolate with rice and fine hazelnut cream. In the preparation of this dessert, his daughter Poppy and Daisy will help him. And in order for this culinary series to end with style, it will prepare an excellent giant chicken kebab and serve it with a pickled mango sauce, humus, spicy herbs, pickled vegetables and buns. R .: Mike Matthews ... / Jamies Comfort Food - (E06, znan. pop. serija, Engleska, 2014) U šestoj epizodi Jamie će omiljeno britansko jelo iz pivnice, šunku s jajima i pomfritom, oplemeniti pikantnom jamajčanskom marinadom. Pripremit će i jednostavno, ali elegantno jelo od tjestenine s finim rakovima, tanko narezanim komoračem i malo ljute papričice. Jamiejev treći recept bit će raskošna čokoladna torta - trokatno remek-djelo punjeno čokoladom s rižom i finom kremom od lješnjaka. U pripremi ove slastice pomoći će mu kćeri Poppy i Daisy. I kako bi ova kulinarska serija završila sa stilom, pripremit će izvrstan divovski pileći kebab i poslužiti ga s umakom od ukiseljenog manga, humusom, tabboulehom od začinskog bilja, ukiseljenim povrćem i lepinjama. R.: Mike Matthews...

programme.title: Endeavour - Young Morse / Endeavour - Mladi Morse

programme.title: Traces of a man / Tragovima pračovjeka
programme.desc: Traces of great -grandson - (E02, Doc. Series, Croatia, 2008) What happened and what were the influences of time during the long geological past of the country? Many evolutionary trails of the oldest human ancestors are marked by the changes of climate and landscape. Africa is the existence of the oldest human communities in which the oldest traces of fire have been found, which we attribute to Praljuva from the time of about one and a half years before our time. Following the traces of humans and animals, we reach our region at the time of tens and hundreds of thousands of years, and these traces reveal to us what the great -grandfather was feeding on, how and what he was preparing for food, where he stayed and how he endured those weather and climate differences. R .: Miljenko Bukovčan ... / Tragovima pračovjeka - (E02, dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2008) Što se zbivalo i kakvi su bili utjecaji vremena tijekom duge geološke prošlosti Zemlje? Mnoge evolucijske staze najstarijih ljudskih predaka obilježene su mijenama klime i krajolika. Afrika je postojbina najstarijih ljudskih zajednica u kojoj su pronađeni i najstariji tragovi vatre koju pripisujemo praljudima iz vremena oko milijun i pol godina prije našeg doba. Prateći tragove ljudi i životinja stižemo i do naših krajeva u vrijeme prije desetaka i stotine tisuća godina, a ti nam tragovi otkrivaju čime se pračovjek hranio, kako je i čime pripremao hranu, gdje je boravio i kako je podnosio te vremenske i klimatske razlike. R.: Miljenko Bukovčan...

programme.title: Picigin on barrels / Picigin na bačvicama
programme.desc: Picigin on Bacvice - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2007) Every quarter, every neighborhood is a small or big city in the city, has its own way of life, sights and secrets, famous and unknown persons, history, present and future. Sometimes parts of the fourth become a sign of recognizing the entire neighborhood. We talk about one such space in our show. Bačvica Bath is part of a famous neighborhood located in the immediate vicinity of the Split port. Picigin on Bacvice is synonymous with the peculiarity of this part of the city and the whole of Split, and the Ministry of Culture has declared it the national cultural property. They are reminding of some of the interesting history of the bathing area and the surrounding space, on the "Picigin on Bacvice" show, we are talking about the phenomenon of this original game or sport that has been played since 1923. Participants are various ages and professions - students, photographers, journalists, writers, professors, engineers, retirees. Hajduk was founded on Bacvice and the first water polo match was played, the rugby is played for decades, nogbi and Glavomet are invented. The third championship of the world in Picigin was organized and the monograph on barrels was promoted. Several festivals of the Adriatic tunes were held in the Summer Cinema area in the early 1960s. R.: Tonko Jovic ... / Picigin na bačvicama - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2007) Svaka četvrt, svaki kvart mali je ili veliki grad u gradu, ima svoj način života, znamenitosti i tajne, poznate i nepoznate osobe, povijest, sadašnjost i budućnost. Ponekad dijelovi četvrti postanu znak prepoznavanja cijeloga kvarta. O jednom takvom prostoru govorimo u našoj emisiji. Kupalište Bačvice je dio poznate četvrti smješteno u neposrednoj blizini splitske luke. Picigin na Bačvicama sinonim je i posebnost ovoga dijela grada i cijeloga Splita, a Ministarstvo kulture proglasilo ga je nacionalnim kulturnim dobrom. Podsjećajujći na dio zanimljive povijesti kupališta i okolnog prostora, u emisiji "Picigin na Bačvicama" govorimo o fenomenu ove izvorne igre ili sporta koji se igra od 1923. godine. Sudionici su razne dobi i zanimanja - studenti, fotografi, novinari, književnici, profesori, inženjeri, umirovljenici. Na Bačvicama je osnovan Hajduk i odigrana prva vaterpolska utakmica, ragbi se igra desetljećima, izmišljeni su nogbi i glavomet. Priređeno je Treće prvenstvo svijeta u piciginu i promovirana monografija o Bačvicama. Nekoliko festivala Melodije Jadrana početkom šezdesetih održano je u prostoru Ljetnog kina. R.: Tonko Jović...

programme.title: Split photorinolaryngology / Splitska fotorinolaringologija
programme.desc: Split photorinolaryngology - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2017) This documentary could be briefly described as: "The City of Split - eye, throat (word), smell and ear" of his photographers and citizens. Of the oldest preserved photographs (first postcards) of famous and unknown authors, from the first cameras who "painted" city motives and people from the mid-19th century, to today's digital and "almighty" photo technology, a number of fantastic details and layers of "the soul of the city" have been rich in a broader documentary. The testimony of the living masters and chronicles of "Split Times" with a picture and word (Dusko Kececemet, Andro Damjanic, Ivo Pervan, Fjodor Klarić, Ante Verzotti, Ana Peraica, Zoran Krpetic, Gordana Benic ... R.: Mladen Santric ... / Splitska fotorinolaringologija - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2017) Ovaj dokumentarni film ukratko bi se mogao opisati kao: "Grad Split - okom, grlom (riječju), njuhom i uhom" njegovih fotografa i građana. Od najstarijih sačuvanih fotografija (prvih razglednica) poznatih i nepoznatih autora, od prvih fotoaparata kojima se od polovice 19. stoljeća "slikavalo" gradske motive i ljude, pa do današnje digitalne i "svemoguće" foto-tehnologije, prebogat je niz fantastičnih detalja i slojeva "duše grada", nikada predočene u širu dokumentarnu filmsku priču. Svjedočenje živućih majstora i kroničara "splitskih vremena" slikom i riječju (Duško Kečkemet, Andro Damjanić, Ivo Pervan, Fjodor Klarić, Ante Verzotti, Ana Peraica, Zoran Krpetić, Gordana Benić....) Film nije kronološka zbirka fotografija o gradu već kaleidoskopska slika doživljaja koje su grad i njegovi ljudi izazvali (i još izazivaju) u oku promatrača. R.: Mladen Santrić...

programme.title: It's time for jazz / Vrijeme je za jazz
programme.desc: Time for jazz - (e02, music. Show, Croatia, 2012) in Kobe in Japan, Makoto Ozone nurtures the intensive career Jazz and the classical musician, merging in their performances a lot of influences. Oscar Peterson, Gary Burton and Duke Ellington are just some of his role models and mentors. Jazz was infected already in early childhood thanks to his father, Jazz Organiš, and was educated at the Berklee College of Music. He attracted the public in 1983. When he held a solo recital in Carnegie Hall, after which he became the first Japanese artist who signed an exclusive contract with CBS and published his first album - Makoto Ozone. Numerous recognitions, including the highest Award of the Japanese government for the contribution to national cultural life, and the nomination for Grammy, follow his career during which he collaborated with the largest names of the international jazz scene. As part of the many guest appearances, in 1988, in Zagreb Jazz Fair, and on Jam Session in B. P. Club where he was musicians with Bosko Petrović. This is his first visit to Zagreb after that. He held two concerts - with the HRT symphonic orchestra and the HRT orchestra. Big band Music is one of the favorite forms of creating Makot Ozone, and in Japan leads its Big Band Name Horses. Some of the concerts of performed compositions were created for that orchestra, while some ozone was performed by solo and in smaller compositions. The program was most of his composition - Cave Walk, Carrots or Bread, Deviation and Jungle - with Jean Pierre Milesa Davis and Crystal Silence Chick Coreae which ozone signs as an arranger. It has not been absent even a supplement - Carney Ricka Henderson. Ozone's exceptional piano creations complemented great with the musician Jazz Orkestra HRT. Р.: СтрокT Гргиц ... / Vrijeme je za jazz - (E02, glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2012) Rođen 1961. u Kobeu u Japanu, Makoto Ozone njeguje intenzivnu karijeru jazz i klasičnog glazbenika, spajajući u svojim izvedbama mnoštvo utjecaja. Oscar Peterson, Gary Burton i Duke Ellington samo su neki od njegovih uzora i mentora. Jazzom se zarazio već u ranom djetinjstvu zahvaljujući ocu, jazz orguljašu, a školovao se na Berklee College of Music. Pažnju javnosti privukao je 1983. kada je održao solistički recital u Carnegie Hallu, nakon čega je postao prvi japanski umjetnik koji je potpisao ekskluzivni ugovor sa CBS-om te objavio svoj prvi album - Makoto Ozone. Brojna priznanja, među kojima su najviša nagrada japanske Vlade za doprinos nacionalnom kulturnom životu te nominacija za Grammy, prate njegovu karijeru tijekom koje je surađivao s najvećim imenima međunarodne jazz scene. U sklopu brojnih gostovanja nastupio je i u Zagrebu 1988. godine, na zagrebačkom Jazz Fairu, te na jam sessionu u B. P. Clubu gdje je muzicirao s Boškom Petrovićem. Ovo je njegovo prvo gostovanje u Zagrebu nakon toga. Održao je dva koncerta - sa Simfonijskim orkestrom HRT-a i Jazz orkestrom HRT-a. Big band glazba jedan je od omiljenih oblika stvaranja Makota Ozonea, a u Japanu vodi i svoj big band No Name Horses. Neke od na koncertu izvedenih skladbi nastale su upravo za taj orkestar, dok je neke Ozone izvodio solistički i u manjim sastavima. Na programu su bile većinom njegove skladbe - Cave Walk, Carrots or Bread, Deviation i Jungle - uz Jean Pierre Milesa Davisa i Crystal Silence Chicka Coreae koje Ozone potpisuje kao aranžer. Nije izostao ni dodatak - Carney Ricka Hendersona. Ozoneove izuzetne pijanističke kreacije sjajno su se nadopunile s muziciranjem Jazz orkestra HRT-a. R.: Tvrtko Grgić...

programme.title: Croatian Kostajnica / Hrvatska Kostajnica
programme.desc: Croatian Kostajnica - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2006) A short historical postcard of Croatian Kostajnica. Since the first mention of the name of Kostajnica in 1240, this settlement spread between the Una River and the Grandpa River, there was also the occasion and goal to many, there were always cultures here, different armies rattled with weapons, different peoples this "city" wanted to call their own. R .: Ljiljana Mandic ... / Hrvatska Kostajnica - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2006) Kratka povijesna razglednica Hrvatske Kostajnice. Od prvog spominjanja imena Kostajnica 1240. godine, ovo naselje razvučeno između rijeke Une i brda Djed, bilo je i povod i cilj mnogima, uvijek su se ovdje susretale kulture, različite vojske su zveckale oružjem, različiti narodi ovaj "grad" čudesni željeli su zvati svojim. R.: Ljiljana Mandić...

programme.title: One work / Jedno djelo
programme.desc: One work - (S08, E06, Artistic Program, Croatia, 2023) The series in 13 eight -minute shows will be addressed by the emergence and meaning of some work of contemporary Croatian fine arts - performance, installation, painting, sculpture or architectural realization. These are works considered to be contemporary classics or have been created recently, and artists and art critics will be discussed. Each of the shows will offer the answer to the question of what each individual work means in today's moment and try to bring it closer to the viewers in an interesting and understandable way. We will present the works of Vojin Bakic, Goran Ostaga, Draga Galic, Slaven Tolja, Josip Seissela, Bozen Koncic Badurina, Josip Zanetti, Ivan Kozaric, Ivan Picelj, Dimitri Basic Mangelos and Marijan Jevšovar ... / Jedno djelo - (S08, E06, umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2023) Serija u 13 osmominutnih emisija bavit će se nastankom i značenjem nekoga djela suvremene hrvatske likovne umjetnosti - performansom, instalacijom, slikom, skulpturom ili arhitektonskom realizacijom. Riječ je o djelima koja se smatraju suvremenim klasicima ili su nastala nedavno, a o njima će govoriti umjetnici i likovni kritičari. Svaka od emisija nudit će odgovor na pitanje što svako pojedino djelo znači u današnjemu trenutku te ga na zanimljiv i razumljiv način pokušati približiti gledateljima. Predstavit ćemo djela Vojina Bakića, Gorana Trbuljaka, Drage Galića, Slavena Tolja, Josipa Seissela, Božene Končić Badurine, Josipa Zanettija, Ivana Kožarića, Ivana Picelja, Dimitrija Bašićevića Mangelosa i Marijana Jevšovara...

programme.title: Ground space / Prizemljeni svemir
programme.desc: Grounded universe - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2018) The poetic vision of Diocletian's Palace, a award -winning poet Gordana Benic, was organized in the film with the merger of the moon landscape of Pag and Split space archeology and the futuristic vision of the Tesla road. The poet's oeuvre is entirely dedicated to the city of Split, and in the film Palace has a dimension of a new reality that the citizens of Split have not seen. The movie title is oxymoron, a paradox as well as poetry in prose Gordana Benic. In 2014, she received the Goran Wreath Award for the entire poetic oeuvre, and for the collection "Heavenly Equator", this year's HAZU Award for Literature. Her poetry has been translated into a dozen foreign languages ​​and books to German and French. She wrote her four books, an imaginary poetic palace on the island of Pag because the palace approaches it so that she moved away from her. Infinity in us is a cosmic component inside the palace that Gordana Benic felt as a child, passing by the sphinx daily. The power of the visuality of her poetry and in the film the viewer brings sensory and spiritual sensations. The film is intended for an audience that has preserved the power to feel artistic energy whose impulse comes from the eye of invisible dimensions and is a consequence of the ground. R .: Lidija Špiranec Ul.: Gordana Benić (Self), Drew Linson (Poetry Reader) ... / Prizemljeni svemir - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2018) Poetska vizija Dioklecijanove palače, nagrađivane pjesnikinje Gordane Benić, u filmu je uprizorena spojem mjesečevog pejzaža Paga i splitske svemirske arheologije te futurističkom vizijom Teslinog puta. Pjesnikinjin opus u cijelosti je posvećen gradu Splitu, a u filmu Palača ima dimenziju nove stvarnosti, kakvu Splićani nisu vidjeli. programme.title: 18. Scream - Rijeka Book Fair and Author Festival - Chronicle / 18. Vrisak - riječki sajam knjiga i festival autora - Kronika
programme.desc: 18. Visak - Rijeka Book Fair and Authors Festival - Chronicle - (E03, Artistic Program, Croatia, 2025) This year's scream, in its adult 18th edition, is held from 13 to 20 September 2025. At seven Rijeka locations, with more than 50 literary and cultural events and participation of more than a hundred authors, artists and guests. This year's festival re -gathers prominent names of the domestic, regional and world literary scene. Among the foreign guests are the Italian writer and winner of the "Straga" Award Veronica Raimo, internationally recognized American author Alexander Hemon, who is also known to the wider audience as one of the screenwriters of the cult film Matrix, Norwegian literary star Oliver Lovren, British author Eleanor Shearr and Palestinian -American writer Etaf Rum. As every year, many authors from Croatia and the region will be joined by foreign guests. Follow conversations with authors in our chronicles ... / 18. Vrisak - riječki sajam knjiga i festival autora - Kronika - (E03, umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2025) Ovogodišnji Vrisak, u svom punoljetnom 18. izdanju, održava se od 13. do 20. rujna 2025. na sedam riječkih lokacija, uz više od 50 književnih i kulturnih događanja i sudjelovanje više od sto autora, umjetnika i gostiju iz Hrvatske i svijeta. Ovogodišnji festival ponovno okuplja istaknuta imena domaće, regionalne i svjetske književne scene. Među stranim su gostima talijanska književnica i dobitnica nagrade "Strega" Veronica Raimo, međunarodno priznati američkobosanski autor Aleksandar Hemon, koji je široj publici poznat i kao jedan od scenarista kultnog filma Matrix, norveška književna zvijezda Oliver Lovrenski, britanska autorica Eleanor Shearer i palestinskoamerička spisateljica Etaf Rum. Inozemnim gostima će se kao i svake godine pridružiti i mnoge autorice i autori iz Hrvatske i regije. Razgovore s autorima pratite u našim kronikama...

programme.title: Ivo Josipovic: Lennon / Ivo Josipović: Lennon
programme.desc: Ivo Josipovic: Lennon - Like Swimming in the Air, HNK Zagreb, 24.04.2023. At the same time, the name of John Lennon, the popular Beatle, the author of legendary hits and a tireless fighter against the establishment and the promoter of peace, expanded the world. The compound of Biennale and Lennon was brought by the 32nd festival edition of 2023, when opera Lennon Ivo Josipovic was premiered in the festival finish on April 22. We bring a recording of the first replay of the play, recorded on April 24, 2023. Flashback in which he remembers the key moments and people in his life in the minutes before his death. As through a dream, in five separate scenes of the overall duration of 80 minutes, various situations from his life are lower. Ivo Josipovic's music is typically postmodernist, at times avant -garde, and yet in moments very classic, rhythmic and singing, typical of his colorful, alive and eclectic music style. The main roles are mostly members of the Zagreb Opera: Tenor Domagoj Dorotic (Lennon), soprano Marija Kuhar Šoša (Yoko Ono), MezzoSoPransist Dubravka Šeparović Musović (May), Basbariton Ozren Bilusic (Lennon's killer Mark David Chapman) (Lennon's aunt Mimi), mezzo-soprano Sofia Ameli Gojić (Lennon's mother Julia), mezzo-soprano Helena Lucić Šego (Lennon's first wife Cynthia), Tenor Dario Curic (Stu, first bass-gitarist Beatles), tenor Sinisa Galovic (Paul McCartney) Radic (Ringo Star), Bariton Sinisa Hapac (George Harrison), Bariton Alen Ruško (Lennon's first son Julian) and bass Sinisa Stork (Brian Epstein, the first manager of the Beatles group). Opera director is Marina Pejnovic and performance ... / Ivo Josipović: Lennon - Like Swimming in the Air, HNK Zagreb, 24.04.2023., snimka - (show magazin, Hrvatska, 2023) Od 60-ih godina prošloga stoljeća uhodana je praksa naručivanja i stvaranja novih glazbenoscenskih djela hrvatskih skladatelja, u suradnji Muzičkog biennala Zagreb i Hrvatskog narodnog kazališta u Zagrebu. U isto vrijeme svijetom se proširilo ime Johna Lennona, popularnog beatlea, autora legendarnih hitova i neumornog borca protiv establishmenta te promicatelja mira. Spoj Biennala i Lennona donijelo je 32. festivalsko izdanje 2023. godine, kad je u festivalskoj završnici, 22. travnja, praizvedena opera Lennon Ive Josipovića. Donosimo snimku prve reprize predstave, zabilježene 24. travnja 2023. Libretistica Marina Biti daje presjek Lennonova života kroz njegovu psihu u trenutku umiranja, tzv. flashback u kojemu se on u minutama pred smrt prisjeća ključnih trenutaka i osoba u svojemu životu. Kao kroz san, u pet odvojenih prizora sveukupnog trajanja 80-tak minuta, nižu se razne situacije iz njegova života. Glazba Ive Josipovića je tipično postmodernistička, na momente avangardna, a opet u trenucima vrlo klasična, ritmična i pjevna, tipična za njegov šarolik, živ i eklektičan glazbeni stil. U glavnim ulogama nastupaju mahom redoviti članovi Zagrebačke opere: tenor Domagoj Dorotić (Lennon), sopranistica Marija Kuhar Šoša (Yoko Ono), mezzosopranistica Dubravka Šeparović Mušović (May), basbariton Ozren Bilušić (Lennonov ubojica Mark David Chapman), sopranistica Kristina Anđelka Đopar (Lennonova teta Mimi), mezzosopranistica Sofia Ameli Gojić (Lennonova majka Julia), mezzosopranistica Helena Lucić Šego (Lennonova prva supruga Cynthia), tenor Dario Ćurić (Stu, prvi bas-gitarist Beatlesa), tenor Siniša Galović (Paul McCarthney), bariton Davor Radić (Ringo Star), bariton Siniša Hapač (George Harrison), bariton Alen Ruško (Lennonov prvi sin Julian) i bas Siniša Štork (Brian Epstein, prvi menadžer grupe The Beatles). Redateljica opere je Marina Pejnović, a izvedb...

programme.title: Django Reinhardt / Django Reinhardt
programme.desc: Django - (biographer. Film, France, 2017) Drama about the life and part of the legendary jazz guitarist Djang Reinhardt during the Second World War in the occupied France. We follow his struggle for survival, an attempt to escape with the family in Switzerland and the adversity facing the Roma community. Apart from Djang's musical genius, the film also speaks of his reluctance to deal with politics and he shows his confrontation with the war reality and the persecution of his people. Р.: Etienne Comar Ul.: Rada Kateb (Django Reinhardt), Cecile de Klerk), Bea Palya, Bimbam Merstein (Negros Reinhardt), Gabriel Mirete (Leveque / La Plume) ... / Django - (biograf. film, Francuska, 2017) Drama o životu i djelu legendarnog jazz gitarista Djanga Reinhardta za vrijeme Drugoga svjetskog rata u okupiranoj Francuskoj. Pratimo njegovu borbu za preživljavanje, pokušaj bijega s obitelji u Švicarsku i nedaće s kojima se suočava zajednica Roma. Osim o Djangovoj glazbenoj genijalnosti, film govori i o njegovoj nevoljkosti da se bavi politikom i te prikazuje njegovo suočavanje s ratnom stvarnošću i progonom njegova naroda. R.: Etienne Comar Ul.: Reda Kateb (Django Reinhardt), Cecile de France (Louise de Klerk), Bea Palya (Naguine Reinhardt), Bimbam Merstein (Negros Reinhardt), Gabriel Mirete (Leveque / La Plume)...

programme.title: Fabrio - Patristika Fluminensia / Fabrio - Patristika Fluminensia
programme.desc: Fabrio - Fluminensia Patristics - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2012) Nedjeljko Fabrio (1937 - 2018), one of the greatest Croatian writers, in this biographical film colorful memories and knowledge of the Adriatic themes, confirms its thesis of history as futile, madness and death. He found his inspiration on the eastern shores of the Adriatic, where throughout history, the Slavic, Romanesque, German and Hungarian political interests and cultural influences were intertwined. The heroes of his Adriatic trilogy (Romani "Exercise of Life", "Berenika's Hair" and "Triemeron") are members of the Croatian and Italian people whose centuries -old relations talk about ancient pervasions and old reach, assimilation and irredentism, emigration and exodus, about the opposition of political ideologies that brought tragedy and death. Fabri's storytelling rhythmically intertwined with scenes from his novels, dramas, or inspired essays that fatefully mark his creative outcomes and round out the artist's portrait. The film is co -financed by the City of Rijeka and the Croatian Audiovisual Center. R .: Bernardin Modric ... / Fabrio - Patristika Fluminensia - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2012) Nedjeljko Fabrio (1937. - 2018.), jedan od najvećih hrvatskih pisaca, u ovom biografskom filmu živopisnim sjećanjima i poznavanjem jadranskih tema potvrđuje svoju tezu o povijesti kao jalovosti, ludilu i smrti. Svoja nadahnuća je nalazio na istočnim obalama Jadrana gdje su se tijekom povijesti isprepletali slavenski, romanski, germanski i mađarski politički interesi i kulturni utjecaji. Junaci njegove jadranske trilogije (romani "Vježbanje života", "Berenikina kosa" i "Triemeron") pripadnici su hrvatskog i talijanskog naroda čiji stoljetni složeni odnosi pričaju o davnim prožimanjima i starim posezanjima, o asimilaciji i iredentizmu, o emigraciji i egzodusu, o oprečnosti političkih ideologija koje su donosile tragediju i smrt. Fabrijevo pripovijedanje ritmički se isprepleće sa scenama iz njegovih romana, drama ili nadahnutih eseja koji sudbinski obilježavaju njegova stvaralačka ishodišta i zaokružuju umjetnikov portret. Film je sufinanciran sredstvima Grada Rijeke i Hrvatskog audiovizualnog centra. R.: Bernardin Modrić...

programme.title: It's time for jazz / Vrijeme je za jazz
programme.desc: Time for jazz - (e02, music. Show, Croatia, 2012) in Kobe in Japan, Makoto Ozone nurtures the intensive career Jazz and the classical musician, merging in their performances a lot of influences. Oscar Peterson, Gary Burton and Duke Ellington are just some of his role models and mentors. Jazz was infected already in early childhood thanks to his father, Jazz Organiš, and was educated at the Berklee College of Music. He attracted the public in 1983. When he held a solo recital in Carnegie Hall, after which he became the first Japanese artist who signed an exclusive contract with CBS and published his first album - Makoto Ozone. Numerous recognitions, including the highest Award of the Japanese government for the contribution to national cultural life, and the nomination for Grammy, follow his career during which he collaborated with the largest names of the international jazz scene. As part of the many guest appearances, in 1988, in Zagreb Jazz Fair, and on Jam Session in B. P. Club where he was musicians with Bosko Petrović. This is his first visit to Zagreb after that. He held two concerts - with the HRT symphonic orchestra and the HRT orchestra. Big band Music is one of the favorite forms of creating Makot Ozone, and in Japan leads its Big Band Name Horses. Some of the concerts of performed compositions were created for that orchestra, while some ozone was performed by solo and in smaller compositions. The program was most of his composition - Cave Walk, Carrots or Bread, Deviation and Jungle - with Jean Pierre Milesa Davis and Crystal Silence Chick Coreae which ozone signs as an arranger. It has not been absent even a supplement - Carney Ricka Henderson. Ozone's exceptional piano creations complemented great with the musician Jazz Orkestra HRT. Р.: СтрокT Гргиц ... / Vrijeme je za jazz - (E02, glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2012) Rođen 1961. u Kobeu u Japanu, Makoto Ozone njeguje intenzivnu karijeru jazz i klasičnog glazbenika, spajajući u svojim izvedbama mnoštvo utjecaja. Oscar Peterson, Gary Burton i Duke Ellington samo su neki od njegovih uzora i mentora. Jazzom se zarazio već u ranom djetinjstvu zahvaljujući ocu, jazz orguljašu, a školovao se na Berklee College of Music. Pažnju javnosti privukao je 1983. kada je održao solistički recital u Carnegie Hallu, nakon čega je postao prvi japanski umjetnik koji je potpisao ekskluzivni ugovor sa CBS-om te objavio svoj prvi album - Makoto Ozone. Brojna priznanja, među kojima su najviša nagrada japanske Vlade za doprinos nacionalnom kulturnom životu te nominacija za Grammy, prate njegovu karijeru tijekom koje je surađivao s najvećim imenima međunarodne jazz scene. U sklopu brojnih gostovanja nastupio je i u Zagrebu 1988. godine, na zagrebačkom Jazz Fairu, te na jam sessionu u B. P. Clubu gdje je muzicirao s Boškom Petrovićem. Ovo je njegovo prvo gostovanje u Zagrebu nakon toga. Održao je dva koncerta - sa Simfonijskim orkestrom HRT-a i Jazz orkestrom HRT-a. Big band glazba jedan je od omiljenih oblika stvaranja Makota Ozonea, a u Japanu vodi i svoj big band No Name Horses. Neke od na koncertu izvedenih skladbi nastale su upravo za taj orkestar, dok je neke Ozone izvodio solistički i u manjim sastavima. Na programu su bile većinom njegove skladbe - Cave Walk, Carrots or Bread, Deviation i Jungle - uz Jean Pierre Milesa Davisa i Crystal Silence Chicka Coreae koje Ozone potpisuje kao aranžer. Nije izostao ni dodatak - Carney Ricka Hendersona. Ozoneove izuzetne pijanističke kreacije sjajno su se nadopunile s muziciranjem Jazz orkestra HRT-a. R.: Tvrtko Grgić...

Series, Croatia, 2009) In the "third day of the series" we will follow the famous fishermen from the island of Sipan in the far south of Croatia, through Vis, all the way to Kvarner. programme.title: Ivo Josipovic: Lennon / Ivo Josipović: Lennon
programme.desc: Ivo Josipovic: Lennon - Like Swimming in the Air, HNK Zagreb, 24.04.2023. At the same time, the name of John Lennon, the popular Beatle, the author of legendary hits and a tireless fighter against the establishment and the promoter of peace, expanded the world. The compound of Biennale and Lennon was brought by the 32nd festival edition of 2023, when opera Lennon Ivo Josipovic was premiered in the festival finish on April 22. We bring a recording of the first replay of the play, recorded on April 24, 2023. Flashback in which he remembers the key moments and people in his life in the minutes before his death. As through a dream, in five separate scenes of the overall duration of 80 minutes, various situations from his life are lower. Ivo Josipovic's music is typically postmodernist, at times avant -garde, and yet in moments very classic, rhythmic and singing, typical of his colorful, alive and eclectic music style. The main roles are mostly members of the Zagreb Opera: Tenor Domagoj Dorotic (Lennon), soprano Marija Kuhar Šoša (Yoko Ono), MezzoSoPransist Dubravka Šeparović Musović (May), Basbariton Ozren Bilusic (Lennon's killer Mark David Chapman) (Lennon's aunt Mimi), mezzo-soprano Sofia Ameli Gojić (Lennon's mother Julia), mezzo-soprano Helena Lucić Šego (Lennon's first wife Cynthia), Tenor Dario Curic (Stu, first bass-gitarist Beatles), tenor Sinisa Galovic (Paul McCartney) Radic (Ringo Star), Bariton Sinisa Hapac (George Harrison), Bariton Alen Ruško (Lennon's first son Julian) and bass Sinisa Stork (Brian Epstein, the first manager of the Beatles group). Opera director is Marina Pejnovic and performance ... / Ivo Josipović: Lennon - Like Swimming in the Air, HNK Zagreb, 24.04.2023., snimka - (show magazin, Hrvatska, 2023) Od 60-ih godina prošloga stoljeća uhodana je praksa naručivanja i stvaranja novih glazbenoscenskih djela hrvatskih skladatelja, u suradnji Muzičkog biennala Zagreb i Hrvatskog narodnog kazališta u Zagrebu. U isto vrijeme svijetom se proširilo ime Johna Lennona, popularnog beatlea, autora legendarnih hitova i neumornog borca protiv establishmenta te promicatelja mira. Spoj Biennala i Lennona donijelo je 32. festivalsko izdanje 2023. godine, kad je u festivalskoj završnici, 22. travnja, praizvedena opera Lennon Ive Josipovića. Donosimo snimku prve reprize predstave, zabilježene 24. travnja 2023. Libretistica Marina Biti daje presjek Lennonova života kroz njegovu psihu u trenutku umiranja, tzv. flashback u kojemu se on u minutama pred smrt prisjeća ključnih trenutaka i osoba u svojemu životu. Kao kroz san, u pet odvojenih prizora sveukupnog trajanja 80-tak minuta, nižu se razne situacije iz njegova života. Glazba Ive Josipovića je tipično postmodernistička, na momente avangardna, a opet u trenucima vrlo klasična, ritmična i pjevna, tipična za njegov šarolik, živ i eklektičan glazbeni stil. U glavnim ulogama nastupaju mahom redoviti članovi Zagrebačke opere: tenor Domagoj Dorotić (Lennon), sopranistica Marija Kuhar Šoša (Yoko Ono), mezzosopranistica Dubravka Šeparović Mušović (May), basbariton Ozren Bilušić (Lennonov ubojica Mark David Chapman), sopranistica Kristina Anđelka Đopar (Lennonova teta Mimi), mezzosopranistica Sofia Ameli Gojić (Lennonova majka Julia), mezzosopranistica Helena Lucić Šego (Lennonova prva supruga Cynthia), tenor Dario Ćurić (Stu, prvi bas-gitarist Beatlesa), tenor Siniša Galović (Paul McCarthney), bariton Davor Radić (Ringo Star), bariton Siniša Hapač (George Harrison), bariton Alen Ruško (Lennonov prvi sin Julian) i bas Siniša Štork (Brian Epstein, prvi menadžer grupe The Beatles). Riječ je o multimedijalnom umjetniku koji se okušao u mnogim područjima umjetnosti, ali mu je zajednička nit za svekoliko umjetničko djelovanje nazivnik: borac protiv turizma. programme.title: On the edge of science / Na rubu znanosti
programme.desc: On the edge of science - (known. Pop. Series, Croatia, 2025) Is there something in a man we could call - a soul? For many, there is no doubt that man has a soul, for many others, it is self -explanatory that the notion of soul is just a fantasy because no one has ever seen it. The idea of ​​the soul is thousands of years old and goes back from pagan times. From the Mesopotamia area she moved to Europe where she experienced her first philosophical processing, such as the one in Aristotle's text "About her soul". Throughout history, there were different understanding of the soul, and in modern times it tried to trace her contemporary technology ... / Na rubu znanosti - (znan. pop. serija, Hrvatska, 2025) Postoji li u čovjeku nešto što bismo mogli nazvati - duša? Za mnoge nema sumnje da čovjek ima dušu, za mnoge druge je pak samorazumljivo da je pojam duše tek fantazija jer nitko je nikad nije vidio. Ideja duše stara je tisućama godina i seže još iz poganskih vremena. S područja Mezopotamije prešla je u Europu gdje je doživjela prvu filozofsku obradu, poput one u Aristotelovom tekstu "O duši". Kroz povijest su postojala različita shvaćanja duše, a u moderna vremena pokušalo joj se ući u trag suvremenom tehnologijom...

programme.title: Jerôme: A look into the blue / Jerôme: Pogled u plavetnilo
programme.desc: Jerôme, Les Yeux Dans Le Bleu - (E01, Doc. Film, France, 2021) Jerôme Delafosse meets different nations in Kenya and shares with them everyday life, trying to understand how it is possible to live in a world without water. Its research begins in a large race, the cradle of humanity. He meets the Samburu tribe, shepherds who realized how to find water sources watching the wild animals and following their example. Then he meets the Rendille tribe, who lead him to the borders of his territory. She learns that Rendillei has been able to reconcile the nomadic lifestyle with extreme living conditions. Finally comes the Turkana Lake, who call the sea of ​​jada, a mythical place where tens of thousands of flames come to reproduce. There he reveals that the communities that settled there before just one generation had to change their lifestyle from the roots. Former shepherds became fishermen. R .: Jerôme Delafosse ... / Jerôme, les yeux dans le bleu - (E01, dok. film, Francuska, 2021) Jerôme Delafosse u Keniji susreće različite narode i dijeli s njima svakodnevni život, nastojeći shvatiti kako je moguće živjeti u svijetu bez vode. Svoje istraživanje počinje u Velikoj rasjednoj dolini, kolijevci čovječanstva. Upoznaje pleme Samburu, pastire koji su shvatili kako naći izvore vode promatrajući divlje životinje i slijedeći njihov primjer. Zatim susreće pleme Rendille, koji ga dovode do granica svog teritorija. Saznaje kako su Rendillei uspjeli pomiriti nomadski način života s ekstremnim životnim uvjetima. Naposljetku dolazi do jezera Turkane, koje zovu More žada, mitskog mjesta gdje dolaze deseci tisuća plamenaca kako bi se razmnožavali. Ondje otkriva kako su zajednice koje su se ondje naselile prije samo jednog naraštaja morale iz korijena promijeniti svoj način života. Nekadašnji su pastiri postali ribari. R.: Jerôme Delafosse...

programme.title: 25 FPS - Kronka / 25 FPS - Kronika
programme.desc: 25 FPS - Chronicle - (E01, Artistic Program, Croatia, 2025) Twenty -first edition of the 25 FPS Festival will be held from 23 to 27 September 2025 at the Zagreb Cinema Cinema, with a solemn opening at the Museum of Contemporary Art. After Zagreb, the festival travels to Rijeka Art-Chino (September 30, October 1 and 3) and to the Split Multimedia Cultural Center (October 30). The Festival will open an exhibition of Italian visual artist Rose Barba called "Meaning Distance" in MSU Zagreb on Tuesday, September 2nd. A total of 25 film titles will be shown in the international competition program, and 5 films in the Croatian Competition Program. According to the festival selector, Marina Kozul, Nika Petkovic and Tena Trstenjak, this year's selection of films is mostly run by the idea of ​​the end of the world we have caused ourselves. The big jury of the 21st Festival 25 FPS is British critic and theorist Erika Bals, Belgian curator Stoffel Debuysere and American director and artist Michael Robinson. The reward in reflections will be decided by the jury of criticism made up of Bartol Babic Vukmir, Dario Dunatov and Vanja Gajic. The festival will also be awarded the Audience Award and the Green DCP Award, which is awarded to Croatian film by the Audio-Visual Research Association of 25 FPS in selection. We also have a rich accompanying program, curled jury members, a panel on the topic of film festivals and their new reality and two audiovisual live performances ... / 25 FPS - Kronika - (E01, umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2025) Dvadeset i prvo izdanje Festivala 25 FPS održat će se od 23. do 27. rujna 2025. u zagrebačkom kinu Kinoteka, uz svečano otvorenje u Muzeju suvremene umjetnosti. Nakon Zagreba, festival putuje u riječko Art-kino (30. rujna, 1. i 3. listopada), te u splitski Multimedijalni kulturni centar (30. listopada). Festival će u utorak 23. rujna otvoriti izložba talijanske vizualne umjetnice Rose Barbe pod nazivom "Meaning Distances" u MSU Zagreb, uz izbor njezinih skulpturnih filmskih instalacija. U međunarodnom natjecateljskom programu bit će prikazano ukupno 25 filmskih naslova, a u hrvatskom natjecateljskom programu Refleksi 5 filmova. Kako najavljuju selektorice festivala, Marina Kožul, Nika Petković i Tena Trstenjak, ovogodišnjom selekcijom filmova ponajviše se provlači ideja kraja svijeta koji smo sami uzrokovali. Veliki žiri 21. Festivala 25 FPS čine britanska kritičarka i teoretičarka Erika Balsom, belgijski kustos Stoffel Debuysere i američki redatelj i umjetnik Michael Robinson. O nagradi u Refleksima odlučivat će žiri kritike koji čine Bartol Babić Vukmir, Dario Dunatov i Vanja Gajić. Na festivalu će se dodijeliti i Nagrada publike te Nagrada Green DCP koji hrvatskom filmu u selekciji dodjeljuje Udruga za audio-vizualna istraživanja 25 FPS. Očekuje nas i bogati popratni program, kurirani programi članova žirija, panel na temu Filmski festivali i njihove nove stvarnosti te dva audiovizualna performansa uživo...

programme.title: Never rarely ever ever / Nikad rijetko katkad uvijek
programme.desc: Never Rarely Sometimes (DRAMA, England, 2020) Faced with unwanted pregnancy and the absence of environmental support, Autumn and its cousin Skylar head on a bold journey across state borders, all the way to New York where abortion is possible. The intimate display of the life of teenagers in the rural part of Pennsylvania was one of the most cheers of that year, won a number of awards and recognitions, among them a silver bear - a large jury award in Berlin. Р.: Илиза Hittman Ul.: Sidney Flanigan (Autumn), Talia Ryder (Skylar), Theodore Pellerin (Jasper), Sharon van Etten (Mother), Ryan Eggold (Ted) ... / Never Rarely Sometimes Always - (drama, Engleska, 2020) Suočene s neželjenom trudnoćom i izostankom podrške okoline, Autumn i njezina rođakinja Skylar kreću na odvažno putovanje preko državnih granica, sve do New Yorka gdje je pobačaj moguć. Intimni prikaz života tinejdžerki u ruralnom dijelu Pennsylvanije bio je jedan od najhvaljenijih filmova te godine, osvojio je niz nagrada i priznanja, među njima Srebrnog medvjeda - Veliku nagradu žirija u Berlinu. R.: Eliza Hittman Ul.: Sidney Flanigan (Autumn), Talia Ryder (Skylar), Theodore Pellerin (Jasper), Sharon Van Etten (Mother), Ryan Eggold (Ted)...

programme.title: Garage / Garaža
programme.desc: Garage - (music. Show, Croatia, 2011) The band founded Toma and Janko (guitar, drum) on May 5, 2005. The name Ruiz just has no special meaning, they just liked it. Since 2007, Marko has been with them, and they have released the EP Taste. They played a hundred concerts in Croatia, Slovenia, Italy and Poland, including in our Music Festival and the Art and Music Festival, and festivals in Slovenia and Poland. 2008 are the winners of the Youngunz Tou's regional competition, and in 2009 they published the debut of Erupt!. Great criticism followed, the album was mastered by a triple winner of Grammy Bob Katz. They also recorded two videos, and in the first half of 2011, the planned "Activist" album Draw the Line Never and Square came out and then Ruiz Radio Revolution album. They do everything on their own (recording, production, promotion, booking) with valuable help of talented friends, support DIY (Do It Yourself) approach and betray for small indie labels. The message of the album is an invitation to take an attitude, draw a line, aware of the criteria in today's society that promotes empty life styles and moral indifference. This is all seriously disturbed by the authentic in man, which is his personality and creativity, and the consequences are seen in society mostly on the increase in aggression and insensitivity among people, especially among young people ... / Garaža - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2011) Bend su 5. svibnja 2005. osnovali Tomi i Janko (gitara, bubanj). Samo ime Ruiz nema posebno značenje, jednostavno im se svidjelo. Od 2007. s njima nastupa i Marko, i u tom sastavu izdali su EP Taste. Odsvirali su stotinjak koncerata po Hrvatskoj, Sloveniji, Italiji i Poljskoj uključujući kod nas In Music festival i Art and Music festival, te festivale u Sloveniji i Poljskoj. 2008. pobjednici su regionalnog natjecanja bendova Youngunz Tou, a 2009. izdaju prvijenac Erupt!. Uslijedile su sjajne kritike, album je masterirao trostruki dobitnik Grammyja Bob Katz. Snimili su i dva spota, a u prvoj polovici 2011. izašao je planirani "aktivistički" album Draw the Line Never a Square, a zatim album Ruiz Radio Revolution. Sve rade sami (snimanje, produkciju, promociju, booking) uz dragocjenu pomoć talentiranih prijatelja, podržavaju DIY (do it yourself) pristup i izdaju za male indie labele. Poruka albuma je poziv da se zauzme stav, povuče crta, osvijeste kriteriji u današnjem društvu koje promovira isprazne životne stilove i moralnu indiferentnost. To sve ozbiljno narušava ono autentično u čovjeku, a to su njegova osobnost i kreativnost, a posljedice toga vide se u društvu najviše u porastu agresije i bešćutnosti među ljudima, osobito među mladima...

programme.title: Millennium trilogy / Trilogija Millennium
programme.desc: Millennium - (E02, Crimea series, Sweden, 2010), police have long since closed an investigation into the disappearance of Harriet Vanger 40 years ago, but in the Klan of Vanger's one, someone cannot forget her: her uncle Henry. In order to shed light on the circumstances of the probable murder, for which he suspected one of his family members, he decides to hire Mikaela Blomkvist, a research journalist convicted of slander. Lisbeth Salander, an asocial hacker, is helping the Blkvist's answers, an asocial hacker of amazing intelligence and photographic memory. In this investigation, the two of them will reveal the dark past of that family, but the powerful clan will not shy away from anything to protect themselves. The research journalist is drawn into an infinitely dark world, and his only guide is the enigmatic hacker Lisbeth Salander. R.: Niels Arden Oplev Ul.: Noomi Rapace (Lisbeth Salander), Michael Nyqvist (Mikael Blomkvist), Lena Endre (Erika Berger), Peter Haber (Martin Vanger), Peter Anderson (Bjurman) ... / Millennium - (E02, krim. serija, Švedska, 2010) Policija je odavno zatvorila istragu nestanka Harriet Vanger otprije 40 godina, no u klanu Vangerovih netko je ne može zaboraviti: njezin stric Henrik. Da bi rasvijetlio okolnosti vjerojatnog ubojstva, za koje sumnjiči nekog od članova svoje obitelji, odlučuje angažirati Mikaela Blomkvista, istraživačkog novinara osuđenog zbog klevete. U potrazi za odgovorima Blomkvistu pomaže Lisbeth Salander, asocijalna hakerica zadivljujuće inteligencije i fotografskog pamćenja. U toj istrazi njih dvoje razotkrit će mračnu prošlost te obitelji, no moćni klan neće prezati ni od čega da se zaštiti. Istraživački novinar uvučen je u beskrajno mračan svijet, a jedina mu je vodilja zagonetna hakerica Lisbeth Salander. R.: Niels Arden Oplev Ul.: Noomi Rapace (Lisbeth Salander), Michael Nyqvist (Mikael Blomkvist), Lena Endre (Erika Berger), Peter Haber (Martin Vanger), Peter Andersson (Bjurman)...

programme.title: EU Talents / Talenti EU regija
programme.desc: EU Region Talents - (Educational Program, Slovenia, 2025) How to respond to the regions of EU Member to demographic challenges? The answers to the questions about the increasingly pronounced problem of brain outflows and growing differences in developing are brought by the show "Talents of the EU Region".
